system.name: DIP
system.one_liner: a dynamic, modality-aware pipeline scheduling framework that separates and rebalances per-modality computation to train large multimodal models (LMMs) efficiently

content.subject: how one multimodal prompt (text+image+video) is tokenized by 3 modality encoders, processed by the backbone, and decoded to audio/image

elements.name: Text encoder
elements.role: encodes the plain-text spans of the prompt into text tokens

elements.name: Image encoder
elements.role: encodes the embedded image into a fixed run of image tokens (256 tokens)

elements.name: Video encoder
elements.role: encodes the embedded video clip into a fixed run of video tokens (4096 tokens)

elements.name: Backbone Model
elements.role: the transformer backbone that consumes the full mixed-modality token sequence and produces output representations

elements.name: Audio decoder
elements.role: decodes part of the backbone's output into a spoken-audio response

elements.name: Image decoder
elements.role: decodes part of the backbone's output into a generated image

elements.name: 6 tokens / 256 tokens / 2 tokens / 4096 tokens
elements.role: counts of tokens produced by each modality span: 6 for the leading text, 256 for the image, 2 for 'in video', 4096 for the video clip

relations.what: text tokens (6 plus 2, from the leading prompt words and 'in video') feed into the backbone's input sequence
256 image tokens feed into the backbone's input sequence
4096 video tokens feed into the backbone's input sequence
part of the backbone's output representation is routed to speech synthesis
part of the backbone's output representation is routed to image generation

content.key_idea: One multimodal prompt mixing text with an embedded image and video is tokenized by three separate modality encoders into one combined sequence for the backbone model, whose output is split back out through an audio decoder and an image decoder.
content.reading_order: Top to bottom: the prompt sentence, then its three colour-matched encoders, then the tokenized sequence with per-span counts, down into the backbone, then out to the two decoders and response.

summary: Figure 2 gives a concrete example of how a large multimodal model (LMM) processes a mixed-modality prompt. The example query, Locate the first appearance of an image in a video clip, embeds an image and a video clip inside text. Three colour-matched modality encoders tokenize their respective spans: a text encoder for the surrounding words (6 and 2 tokens), an orange image encoder for the embedded image (256 tokens), and a blue video encoder for the video clip (4096 tokens). All tokens are concatenated into one sequence fed into the Backbone Model, whose output fans back out to an audio decoder producing a spoken response and an image decoder producing a generated image, together yielding the mixed text and image response shown below the diagram.
summary_zh: 图2示例说明LMM如何处理多模态提示：文本、图像、视频编码器分别处理文字与嵌入的图片(256token)、视频(4096token)，拼接后送入Backbone Model，再分流给音频解码器与图像解码器，生成文字、语音与图像混合回应。
